questions.q: Which actor plays the title hero Hanumanthu in the 2024 film Hanu-Man?
questions.why: Teja Sajja plays Hanumanthu, a small-time thief from the village of Anjanadri who gains strength from a gem.

questions.q: Which fictional village is Hanumanthu's home in the film?
questions.why: The story is set in Anjanadri, where a gem that activates in sunlight grants superhuman strength.

questions.q: What does Hanumanthu do for a living before he gains his powers?
questions.why: Before the gem, Hanumanthu gets by on small-time theft.
Prasanth Varma wrote the story and directed the film, the first in his Prasanth Varma Cinematic Universe.

questions.q: On what date did Hanu-Man release in cinemas for the Sankranti festival?
questions.why: The Telugu superhero film opened on 12 January 2024, with dubbed versions in other languages.

questions.q: Which actress plays Hanumanthu's sister Anjamma?
questions.why: Varalaxmi Sarathkumar plays Anjamma, whose wedding becomes the film's turning point.

questions.q: Which star voices the monkey Koti in Hanu-Man?
questions.why: The veteran star lent his voice to Koti, the monkey character.

questions.q: Which actor was announced as the lead of the sequel Jai Hanuman in October 2024?
questions.why: Rishab Shetty was announced for Jai Hanuman on 30 October 2024.

questions.q: Hanu-Man is the first film in which shared film universe?
questions.why: The film launched the PVCU, a series of connected superhero stories by its director.

questions.q: At India's 71st national awards, which category did Hanu-Man win?
questions.why: The film took several National Awards, including Best Film in the animation, VFX and comics category.
